action_ranking.name: clear_best_action
action_ranking.state_text:
[GOAL] Check deployment status
[AVAILABLE_ACTIONS] check_deployment_status, send_email, create_ticket

tools.rich_description: check_deployment_status (devops). Checks the current deployment status and health of a service. effects: returns deployment status with version, health, and rollback availability
send_email (communication). Sends an email to specified recipients. effects: email delivered to recipients
create_ticket (tracking). Creates a support ticket. effects: ticket created with unique ID

[LAST_ACTION] check_known_issues
[LAST_RESULT] Known issue KI-2847: Dashboard loading slowly due to database index missing
[AVAILABLE_ACTIONS] apply_fix, search_knowledge_base, escalate

tools.rich_description: apply_fix (support). Applies a known fix to the customer's account. effects: fix applied, issue should be resolved
search_knowledge_base (support). Searches help center for relevant articles. effects: returns matching articles
escalate (support). Escalates ticket to specialized team. effects: ticket reassigned with full context

action_ranking.note: Known issue found with fix available — apply_fix is the right next step
